title: Model B marginal-preserving analysis: JRSI Round-2 reproducibility release
description: Code, immutable states, seed ledgers, numerical source tables, scientific outputs and validation records for JRSI manuscript rsif-2026-0516. Round-2 probability-space marginal-preserving intervention is primary. The MP operator is a provenance-documented functional reconstruction. Manuscript and Supplement prose, TeX sources and complete document PDFs are maintained separately. The 14 standalone current figure PDFs and a validated portable figure build are included. Full regeneration scope is described in the archived evidence matrix.
